verdict.rationale: The portal's own pages show online registration and login, an entry point to tax services ('Aceda aos Serviços Tributários'), and one concrete online transaction: adhering to electronic notifications in one's own name or as a representative. That is enough to show transactions happen online. However, the core tax transactions (filing returns, paying taxes, registering business activity) are never explicitly described as completable online in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit published confirmation that tax returns can be filed online, online tax payment, online business activity registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
